messages:
olivia: quick alert 1: p99 for embeddings eu-west1 jumped ~30% after last quant push. small customer impact on long jobs. recommending hotfix revert to v2.2.11 for eu-west1 only.
sre_oncall: share telemetry link and abort criteria pls.
olivia: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/embeds?region=eu-west1. abort if 5xx > 0.5% or p99 regresses >20% sustained 5m.
matt: infra ok for staged revert. i'll own rollout. propose slices 1% -> 10% -> 100% manual gates.
deploybot: @matt scheduled deploy id=dr-1769999997-a. strategy=staged-canary slices=[1%,10%,100%]; checks=[health,p95,p99,5xx]; manual approval required between stages.
sre_oncall: I approve canary. monitor golden queries and error budget.
matt: starting 1% canary now. logs: dr-1769999997-a canary-start.
matt: 6m update: p95 down 12%, p99 down 25%, 5xx stable. green to 10%.
deploybot: progressing to 10% slice.
matt: 12m at 10% stable. proceeding to 100%.
deploybot: deploy complete dr-1769999997-a -> status=success slices=100%.
olivia: rollback one-liner if needed:
``
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/embeddings --to-revision=deploy-v2.3.6-quant && kubectl rollout status -n prod deploy/embeddings
``
sre_oncall: monitoring post-deploy for 30m, filing RCA ticket for quant path. thanks team :thumbsup:
